title: Siege of Saati
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Saati", at revision 1381386305, opens: "The siege of Saati, also known as battle of Saati or combat of Saati, was the first battle of the Italo-Ethiopian War of 1887–1889 between Italian colonial troops and Ethiopian forces." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2984870, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "first battle of the Italo-Ethiopian War of 1887–1889". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
